backend_matrix.reason: The standalone one-way H1/P1 charge solve, RT0/Oersted field basis, immutable field-solution artifact and solved-drive consumer have source implementations. Their combined native solve-to-LLG workflow has not passed the required managed runtime, integrator and scientific gates.
Field precomputation remains FEM CPU. A FEM GPU solved-drive consumer has source code, but no qualified device-resident trajectory, quantity and parity evidence; GPU field solve is unsupported.

The immutable FEM field basis is projected to certified FDM cell centres and consumed by the FDM CPU reference implementation. A public solve-to-LLG scenario and scientific/runtime validation remain missing.

The FDM GPU lane has source paths for the resolved projected basis and waveform evaluation, but no managed double-precision device parity or complete trajectory proof; silent CPU fallback remains forbidden.
